description: Backtest: our acquisition model valuation vs 2026 closed sales. model_value_at_10pct is the price bisected to hit exactly 10% levered IRR using template defaults and RentCast rent. ratio = model_value / actual_price.
rentcast_spec: 2BR/1BA/850sf Apartment (standard spec for small BR/NOLA working-class multifamily)
model_defaults: pymodel defaults: 8% mgmt (under 50 units), payroll=0 (under 20 units), insurance=$2,000/unit, expense_growth=2.5%, vacancy=7%, bad_debt=0.5%, DSCR=1.30, LTV=75%, rate=6.75%, amort=25yr, hold=5yr, cost_of_sale=3%, exit_cap=going-in+50bps. Taxes via latax.estimate_tax at actual_price.

sales.name: 310 9th St Gretna (8-unit)
sales.notes: IRR at actual slightly above 10%; model and market closely agree. Jefferson Parish (Gretna).

sales.name: 2114 Toledano St NOLA (8-unit)
sales.notes: Buyer paid $81k/unit on a property with $1,570/mo rents; our model says it was worth $983k. Garden District / Uptown adjacent. RentCast range $1,090-$2,040 wide; high uncertainty.

sales.name: N Coronet Ct NOLA (12-unit)
sales.notes: Model says buyer slightly overpaid (ratio 0.98). Going-in cap 8.3% at actual price; thin but defensible in eastern NOLA. CA buyer GMD Management may have accepted sub-10% IRR.

sales.name: 1913 7th St NOLA (10-unit)
sales.notes: Buyer paid $68k/unit on a Central City / Garden District adjacent asset with $1,430/mo rents. Significant apparent underpricing vs DCF value; possible deferred maintenance or seller distress not reflected in RentCast rent.

sales.name: 2747 Huron St BR (16-unit)
sales.notes: Largest outlier: buyer paid $37.9k/unit in Huron St area (lower BR). RentCast comparables range $479-$1,495 with high variance, suggesting mixed submarket. Model implies value $1.1M but actual was $606k. Property likely in poor condition - comps may not reflect actual achievable rents here.

sales.name: 4870 Alsace St NOLA (16-unit)
sales.notes: Model says buyer substantially overpaid (ratio 0.80). 6.5% going-in cap with $1,170/mo rent suggests either strong value-add thesis or compression bet the model does not price. Actual RentCast comp at same address shows $950/mo - buyer may underwrite higher stabilized rents.

sales.name: 2221 N Johnson St NOLA (10-unit)
sales.notes: Mid-City / 7th Ward adjacent. Model implies ~24% upside to market price at a 10% IRR hurdle. Reasonable for the neighborhood.
